description: EPANET-PMX adds a dynamic pressure-reducing-valve model to EPANET 3 and implements fixed-outlet, time-modulated, flow-modulated and remote-node pressure management. The deposit includes the extension and a DMA200 network archive. This resource is provided by Koşucu, Mehmet Melih. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists RAR formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Implementation on one distribution network is reported; broader validation and current engine compatibility are unverified. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
